impacts.text: `previewWithdraw` reverts with a UD60x18 underflow for the vast majority of deposit amounts.

Any external integration, UI, or on-chain contract calling `BondingCurveRegistry.previewWithdraw` (which delegates to `ProgressiveCurve.previewWithdraw`) will encounter an unexpected revert when querying a full withdrawal.

This breaks the public API contract where `previewWithdraw(totalAssets, totalAssets, totalShares)` should return `totalShares` for a full withdrawal, and never revert for valid inputs (`assets <= totalAssets`).
`OffsetProgressiveCurve` shares the same root cause in its `previewWithdraw` function at the same line range.
Only the `previewWithdraw` view function is broken.
